pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

5. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

6. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   B. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

9. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

10. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Red, blue, and yellow

2. D — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — The speed of the music

5. A — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. A — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elements of Music RESPONDING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Singing Games; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
